observation_summary: RSI cycle 2026-06-05 — director long-tenure signal + sector peer governance ranking
actions_taken: Two new signal types added to the entity graph. (1) director_long_tenure: ScoreLongTenure scans the in-memory graph for directors whose FirstAppearance at a ticker is >LongTenureYearsThreshold years ago (default 12, configurable). Per ISS/Glass Lewis governance standards, long-tenured directors (>12 years) may lack independence from management. Medium severity for 12-14 years, high for 15+. Added as -0.06 penalty to governance_health_index. (2) governance_peer_underperformer: ScorePeerGovernanceRank compares each ticker's health score to its sector median; fires when a ticker is >PeerGovernanceUnderperformThreshold (default 0.15) below peers. Medium severity for gap 0.15-0.24, high for >=0.25. Added as -0.10 penalty to governance_health_index. Both wired into cmd/entity-graph/main.go. Watchlist sector annotations added for all 50 tickers (GICS-style sectors). 10 new tests all pass. Full suite: 30 packages pass go test ./...
notes: Sector peer comparison provides the context that was previously missing from governance health scores — a 0.70 score is very different when the sector median is 0.85 vs 0.60. Long-tenure signal closes the ISS/Glass Lewis proxy advisory gap in the signal taxonomy. Both signals are config-driven thresholds that Claude Code can tune in entity-graph-rules.json.
